card.statement:
Let $X$ be a smooth, connected scheme, and let $\mathcal{F}$ be a constructible complex of $\Bbbk$ -sheaves on $X$ that satisfies the following conditions:

•

For every prime ideal $\mathfrak{p}\subset\Bbbk$, the complex $\kappa(\mathfrak{p})\otimes_{\Bbbk}^{L}\mathcal{F}$ has locally constant cohomology sheaves.

•

For each $m\in\mathbb{Z}$, the integer

$\rank\mathcal{H}^{m}(\kappa(\mathfrak{p})\otimes_{\Bbbk}^{L}\mathcal{F})$

is independent of $\mathfrak{p}$.

Then for all $m\in\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathcal{H}^{m}(\mathcal{F})$ is a locally constant sheaf whose stalks are free $\Bbbk$ -modules, of rank the rank of $\mathcal{H}^{m}(\kappa(\mathfrak{p})\otimes_{\Bbbk}^{L}\mathcal{F})$ for any $\mathfrak{p}\subset\Bbbk$.
card.label: Lemma A

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
